Mint spreads underground and will pop up everywhere. I liked that you have it confined to a small plot surrounded by hardscape, so it might at least be restricted there. Like middle_path said, your sage might get overrun though.

One thing you can do is to harvest the mint regularly - get in there and cut it all the way to the ground every three or four weeks. That will keep the mint under control (or keep you under its control, depending on how you see it) - but it will grow back nice and thick. If you don't harvest, it will get all leggy and terrible looking. Every time you harvest, sprinkle a bit of blood-meal and epsom salt.
